top_strength: Jevic gathered detailed logistics comprehensively, including multi-location coordination, walking distances, storage unit sizes, and itemization—and personalized the estimate meaningfully to the 2,100 sq ft reference move with 7.5–8.5 hour range and two-truck crew.
coaching_note: Never ask the two-concerns question (step 2), never deliver the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage promises with a permission lead-in (step 3), never check for remaining concerns at step 6, and critically, never ask for the business (step 7)—you talked yourself out of a close by letting the customer drive to email instead of holding the ask.
